project_type: Mock test generation system for JKSSB Sub-Inspector exam prep
language: JSON (test files), Python (record script), Markdown (study plan/steering)
test_framework: python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py <N> validates and records each test
verification_instructions: After generating each test JSON, run python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py <N> from the repo root. It validates the file exists, appends fingerprints to history shards, updates config.json, manifest.json, and STUDY_PLAN.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: mock-tests/tests/*.json are generated test files. mock-tests/history/*.json, mock-tests/config.json, mock-tests/manifest.json, and STUDY_PLAN.md are updated by _record_test.py.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Python3 is available.
environment_constraints: No network needed for test generation. Tests are generated as JSON content by the AI agent itself.
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/mock-test-prompt-si.md exactly for question format, type counts, difficulty distribution, and anti-duplication rules.
key_patterns: Each test is a JSON file with subject, topic, total_questions, and questions array. Each question has id, subject, questionText, options (4), correctAnswer (exact match to one option), explanation (why correct + why each wrong is wrong). Question types must follow Section 1 count table. History shards track stems to prevent duplicates.
directory_structure: Root: README.md, STUDY_PLAN.md, syllabus_si.md, mock-tests/. mock-tests/: config.json, manifest.json, _record_test.py, tests/ (generated test JSONs), history/ (A-F.json fingerprint shards). .kiro/steering/ has the generation prompt.
